angle: WR/TE break mechanics from Combine route drills (brake into the break, speed through it, drive out) matched to the same NFL route families (SLANT/OUT/HITCH/IN/CORNER), tested against separation over expected and targets per route; one named metric, Break G
metric_name: Break G: mean acceleration magnitude (g) over the 1.0 s centred on the sharpest turn of a route break, standardized within drill x Combine year, averaged over route drills, shrunk by drill count, in sd of true Break G (definition frozen since round 5)
headline_number: Career TPRR +1.93 pct pts per sd (95% CI 0.02 to 3.78, n=116 WR/TE, given log pick/40/weight/NGS/TE); planning number 1.4 pts, about 7 targets per 500-route season; held-out R2 +7.4% [-10.0, 17.7], by class +10.7 / -0.8 / +2.7%. Separation: same 112 players, Break G effect on SOE -0.19 sd [-0.45, 0.04], NGS separation -0.04; SOE vs TPRR rho 0.06, so the two do not conflict.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_06/cand_2 (7.42) against its three fatal flaws plus the round-6 winner's feedback. (1) New Fig 1: one forest plot on a common n=112 (TPRR, YPRR, NGS separation, SOE in outcome-sd units) next to a per-class TPRR panel with held-out R2 change shown in red when negative; neutral titles, no 'all positive' claim. (2) The TPRR vs SOE contradiction is reconciled with a new analysis: player SOE barely relates to TPRR beyond baseline (rho 0.06 [-0.13, 0.25]), and controlling SOE moves the Break G slope only 1.93 -> 1.88 (Fig 4C). (3) Fig 2 is now like for like: speed and acceleration profiles of all a player's drill reps vs all his NFL breaks in the same 1.0 s window, aligned on the sharpest turn, which also shows the brake/turn/drive-out phases. (4) Nested screen: the 36-pair screen re-run inside each held-out fold picks other pairs and loses -31.8% R2 on average (Break G ranks 10/8/7 in-fold), reported in the main table. Also new: ridge on all nine break measures (-4.8%), one-class power (0.23), a rule table, a pick-195-vs-191 draft-room example (Perry vs Palmer), and one pair statistic (6 of 9). (5) Plain title, two-sentence lede, three-beat motivation, one-line coach definition, jargon glossed, appendix cut. (6) The writeup is rendered from writeup_template.md, and numbers.json keeps only the quoted values with a claim-to-section map (184 keys, no orphans). 1,935 words by check.py, 4 figures + 3 tables.
open_risks: Forking path: TPRR was chosen as the outcome after round 5; the nested screen shows the search procedure does not generalize (-31.8%), so the result rests on the frozen definition alone
Fragile: the CI lower bound is 0.02, dropping Puka Nacua halves the slope (t 1.93), unweighted t is 1.75, and in the 3-cone complete-case subset (n=38) the slope is -0.94
Only the 2023 class clears zero; 2024 held-out R2 is -0.8% and the one-class power is 0.23
Mechanism unknown: Break G does not carry into NFL cut force (the 0.07 g drill gap is 0.01 g in NFL breaks) or separation, so 'break' describes the drill only
Plus calls hit 50%; the usable signal is the downgrade side with n=9 minus WRs
The Break G-SOE point estimate is negative (-4.5 in per sd); the CI includes zero, but judges may still read it as a cost
